summary: Tested the iteration-7 features (business/comercio role, open orders and accept, profile photos, business accounts, register-push) on the backend and the Expo web frontend (375x667). Backend: 14 of 15 new pytest tests pass. The one failure: POST /api/biz/orders returns pickup/dest coordinates (only the GET endpoints strip them). Everything else works. Business login returns role=business. Business account PUT/DELETE is owner only, with 409 for an email already used by a business or the owner and 422 for a short password. account_email appears on GET /businesses/{bid}. /biz/* returns 403 for owner and courier tokens, and businesses are isolated from each other (404). /biz/couriers has no lat/lng. A business order with no courier gets open=true; with courier_id it is assigned. Biz cancel works only on nuevo/preparacion and sets open=false. Accept is atomic (the second accept gets 409) and the order moves to the courier's active list. Owner orders with open=true become open; assigning sets open=false. Profile photos upload as multipart and b64; GET /users/{uid}/photo works for the courier, the owner and the business, gives 404 for another courier and 401 for a bad token. register-push returns a clean JSON 500 and order creation still succeeds. A business token gets 403 on all owner endpoints. Frontend: all requested flows work. Login has 3 tabs. Business login goes to /biz. The new order screen in business mode has no business chips and no 'Sin asignar' option, only 'Libre' plus couriers with avatars. Creating an order opens /biz-order/{id} with the courier card and timeline, and no map. Courier 'Tareas libres' and accept-{n} work and move the task to active. The courier avatar opens the profile photo sheet. Owner business detail shows business-account-row and the sheet; saving works. Owner couriers list shows avatars. Deprecated packages detected: none.

minor.issue: Returns build_order() -> o.model_dump(), which includes pickup_lat/pickup_lng/dest_lat/dest_lng. The GET /biz/orders[/{id}] endpoints strip them through biz_order(). Wrap the response: return biz_order(created doc) or model_dump(exclude=...). server.py:1224

Returns set_status() output (full Order dump with coordinates). The response is also built BEFORE open=False is written, so it still says open=true for open orders. Re-read the order after the update and return biz_order(). server.py:1246-1250
On an already cancelled or delivered order the error message is 'Solo puedes cancelar pedidos que aún no se han recogido', which is misleading for cancelled orders.

Active orders are unassigned (courier_id=None) but keep open=false, so business-created orders become orphaned: not open, so no courier sees them in 'Tareas libres'. Consider setting open=True for created_by=business orders. server.py:795

ui_bugs.issue: React Query key collision. order/new.tsx:30 uses queryKey ['biz-me'] with a queryFn that returns an ARRAY [Business]. biz.tsx:25 uses the same key ['biz-me'] for a single Business OBJECT. Opening /order/new after /biz briefly reads the object (no .length), so the footer/submit is hidden and bizId stays null until the refetch. Back on /biz, me.data is an array, so the title falls back to user.name. Use a different key (e.g. ['biz-me-list']) or keep the same shape.
For a cancelled order the 'Seguimiento' timeline only shows 'Nuevo' and never a 'Cancelado' step. The call-courier button is still shown on cancelled orders.
'Quitar acceso' deletes the business login instantly, with no confirmation step.

issues: When the courier text is long ('Esperando que un repartidor acepte…'), the total '3,00 €' wraps onto 2 lines. Give the total flexShrink:0 (biz.tsx:64 / style total).
'Hola, Carlos' wraps onto 2 lines at 375px next to the online switch, SOS and logout buttons. Consider numberOfLines={1} or a smaller font.

action_items: Strip coordinates from the POST /api/biz/orders and PATCH /api/biz/orders/{id}/cancel responses (use biz_order()), and return open=false after cancel
Fix the ['biz-me'] queryKey collision between biz.tsx (object) and order/new.tsx (array)

Optional: show a 'Cancelado' step in the biz-order timeline and hide the call button when cancelled; add a confirmation to 'Quitar acceso'; re-open business orders when their courier is deleted; prevent the total wrapping on the biz card
critical_code_review_comments: Owner and business share POST /auth/login. Email uniqueness across roles is enforced only in PUT /businesses/{bid}/account (the owner register is disabled), which is fine today.
The photo URL passes the JWT as a ?token= query param (it can show up in proxy/access logs). This is an accepted pattern for <Image>, but consider short-lived photo tokens.
server.py is 1414 lines, above the 700-line guideline. Split it into routers (auth, biz, courier, orders).
